newsitem.title: USA: Department 56 to buy back 1.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Department 56 to buy back 1.5 mln shares.

text.p: Department 56 Inc's directors have authorized the repurchase of up to 1.5 million shares of the company's stock in the open market through the end of June 1998, the company said Tuesday.
If fully exercised, the authorization would reduce the number of Department 56 shares currently outstanding by about seven percent.
The timing, prices and amounts of shares repurchased will be determined at the discretion of management based on its view of prevailing economic and market conditions.
Department 56 said it has a very strong cash flow which provides funds to repurchase shares while continuing to invest in the company's growth.
Department 56 designs, imports and distributes collectibles and other specialty giftware products sold through gift and home accessory retailers.
Shares of Department 56 closed up 1/4 at 23-7/8.
